correctness.rationale: For every even-length prefix of any complement, discrepancy of a minus b is both even and within [-1,1], hence zero; residual pairs are ab/ba. At each pair start the parity of previously deleted alternating-word letters is 0 for ab and 1 for ba, so each new ba-run consumes a distinct deleted a, bounding runs by k. Conversely each run (ba)^q is obtained by deleting first a and last b from (ab)^(q+1); concatenate and pad to k deletions. Choosing 2r run boundaries among m+1 gives C(m+1,2r), and Pascal gives the binomial tail. The independent exhaustive checker passed 78 pairs with n<=11.
